purpose: One predefined training-only comparison of frame-head class weighting
split: Per sensor, stratify training sequences by any background support; SHA256-rank within each stratum, hold out indices 0,3,6,... once. No split retries. Both classes must be available in fit and heldout samples.
features: Reuse only hashed clean training features from the expanded diagnostic. Fit standardization after the sequence split, on fitting frames only.
natural_prevalence: Use original annotation prevalence of fitting training sequences for the entire CE+KL objective, correcting sampled class frequencies
class_balanced: Give each class half of total CE+KL weight; all other settings unchanged
controls: Same initialization within each objective pair; fixed architecture, 50 full-batch epochs, optimizer, KL schedule and gradient cap. No early stopping or best-seed selection.
evaluation: Report raw, uncalibrated held-out training probabilities: per-class recall, balanced accuracy, natural-prevalence-weighted Brier and log loss, training-prior constant reference, losses and sequence support. Report all three seeds; no prior correction or calibration fitted here.
limits: Head-level sequence holdout only: frozen detectors were previously trained on the whole original training split. Correlated frames are descriptive observations. Official validation/test data and conflict/corruption scores do not select the objective; this comparison cannot authorize production by itself.
